title: Workaholism
coreMove: Unsustainable effort is not proof of value; measure work by useful results, clear judgment, and whether the method can be repeated without exhaustion.

exampleSpecs.stakes: replace recurring heroics with a scope decision
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist uses the real hero already home contrast

exampleSpecs.stakes: stop using overtime as proof of loyalty
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist measures results rather than public strain

exampleSpecs.stakes: keep quality high without rewarding constant availability
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist distinguishes focused intensity from chronic overwork

exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid making burnout a leadership signal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist rejects workaholism as a status badge

exampleSpecs.stakes: use temporary intensity without turning it into culture
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist respects a focused burst but limits it

exampleSpecs.stakes: keep sane schedules from looking lazy
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist changes a norm that rewards constant replies
